My Bengal cat was cured!
Many doctors had examined her and couldn't find a solution.
Thanks to Dr. Angy ❤️
Highly trained doctors. Clean facilities and friendly service. Accurate diagnoses and results.

I've been taking my dog ​​to the vet for about three years now, and we've been through various departments, from general consultations to ophthalmology, orthopedics, lab work, X-rays, and ultrasound. In each department, we've received excellent, timely care, with clear, friendly, and well-explained procedures for my little one.

My dog ​​is 17 years old, so we've navigated some changes in his health, but I've definitely noticed improvement and stabilization in each department we've visited.

They are excellent veterinarians, providing a very professional and dedicated service. They literally saved my cat's life after he was diagnosed with a complex autoimmune disease. They took him in during a severe crisis and managed to stabilize him and bring him into remission.

Dr. Laura is incredibly attentive, professional, and very effective in her treatments. What I especially appreciate is her close follow-up, even remotely.

I highly recommend them; they are a fantastic clinic.
Excellent care, they always rescue my baby, thank you thank you 🙏🏼 …

The care is good and they are attentive. Dr. Miguel Ángel Capulín Sánchez is an excellent person and took excellent care of my Ducke. I am grateful that they helped and saved my puppy 🐕💕🫂 Thank you so much 😊 …
Great service! I've been taking my pets there for two and a half years. The staff is friendly and attentive. Currently, Dr. Angy Olvera is treating my puppies, and the care is excellent.
Overall, both the facilities and the medical and administrative staff are excellent! The treatment prescribed by Dr. Andrea has worked well for my dog.

Excellent service. Their assessment is very thorough; they don't prescribe medication to your pet without first knowing their health status through tests to avoid harming their organs. Both the doctors and receptionists are very friendly, and I love that they respect appointments. They are very well organized.

I took my German Shepherd in for allergy issues, which subsided with the treatments he received. So satisfied with the service and treatment that I also brought my other two dogs in for vaccinations and checkups. Completely satisfied with the service, treatment, and kindness.
Excellent service, the veterinarians' care is wonderful; they treat my dogs with love, but above all, they are very knowledgeable.

Their facilities are welcoming, and the service is always incredibly professional. My kitten always felt safe and secure, and I felt completely at ease leaving him at the hospital. The doctors explain everything perfectly and with great patience. Highly recommended.

I've been taking my Chihuahua, Max, to Dermavet since last year for a spinal problem. He received excellent care from the doctors and staff. He was very comfortable during his hospitalization and rehabilitation. Despite being a Chihuahua, he loves going to the vet because everyone treats him well and always greets him. Seeing the good treatment he received, I decided to bring my other two dogs, a German Shepherd (Sam) and a caramel-colored mix (Galleta). Galleta usually gets very nervous with other vets and is afraid of injections, but at Dermavet, she feels confident and receives the same good treatment. Dr. Miguel is very professional and has treated Galleta very well regarding her tumors. Dr. Andrea treats Sam and Max; she's also very kind and professional.
At Dermavet I found very dedicated specialists who have provided excellent care for my babies! I highly recommend them!!!

Hello, good afternoon... I have a very large group of cats in my care... I love kittens, and at Dermavet I've found a high-quality, caring, and professional veterinary service for them... Every veterinarian who has treated my cats has helped them with their health problems... A special thank you to Dr. Andrea, who has practically become my cats' go-to veterinarian... Dermavet is excellent!!!
Veterinary dermatology consultation
They have trained, attentive staff who provide excellent recommendations for our little ones. I highly recommend them.
Excellent service, the staff is empathetic with both humans and animal patients.
Excellent service. I take my dogs to physiotherapy and they've made great progress. Angie is the veterinarian who has treated my pets, and her care and attention have always been excellent.
I loved the care my dog ​​received from vet Angy Olvera; it's a very clean place and the service is very professional.

I took my dog ​​there, who already had a supposed diagnosis with a very high probability of mortality. Other hospitals had practically given her up for dead without even doing any tests. What I loved most is that as soon as we arrived, they immediately ran all sorts of tests to find out what was wrong with her, and they were able to save my Cleo's life… The only downside, which I think is a precaution, is that they don't see first-time patients in emergencies. But if an acquaintance or family member has pets there, they can schedule a first appointment if it's an emergency. I love them all, but especially Dr. Lidia 🤎🫶🏻
An excellent place, they managed to save my dog ​​when he was a puppy, very professional doctors and very good customer service.

I own Ruperto, my pet had an accident and can't move his hind legs. Dr. Angy has been giving him therapy; she's very nice, explains things well, and is very attentive to us as owners. She's also very professional and caring with the pets. He has rehabilitation once a week.

Good morning!
Excellent service!
Ms. Erika recommended this hospital to me.
Dr. Angy is very kind and provides excellent care.
She loves animals, and the care she's given my pets is top-notch.
Congratulations to all the staff for their excellent service! I give them five stars! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Excellent service and excellent treatment of the animals.
Dr. Angy Olvera provides excellent care. She's very kind and treats the dogs wonderfully; they're always in good hands. I highly recommend her.

Dr. Angui, the physiotherapist, is one of the best. Candy always enjoys going because they pamper her so much. Plus, Dr. Angui always explains the exercises very well, showing you how to do them at home and giving you her recommendations. 100% recommended.

It's a very good service, I highly recommend it. It's very fast and very good. My dog ​​was treated very well, and thanks to the veterinarian Angy Olvera, she explained the entire procedure very well and took excellent care of my dog.

A huge thank you to Dr. Claudia and the entire Dermavet team! I arrived extremely worried about my dog's health problems, but the doctor treated her with incredible patience and care. 100% recommended!

I think Dermavet Hospital is excellent, especially since we hadn't found one like it in this area. It has all the necessary specialties, and we've received excellent care from reception to both doctors, particularly Dr. Angy, who is treating my little ones. She's been very attentive to them both in person and by phone, and her approach is very kind and professional.
The only thing I would like to see at Dermavet Hospital is if they could offer 24-hour service.

They've been a huge help with my dogs, two senior Chihuahuas with heart problems and paw issues.
Docs Angy and Nora have guided us from the start, and they're still helping us with Quesito's physical therapy ❤️

Excellent care! Dr. Angye Olvera, the physiotherapist, is very professional, providing excellent care and follow-up for her patients. My dog ​​was treated by her after patellar surgery, and I am very grateful for the results. She is also a very empathetic person.

My experience with Dr. Angye Olvera's physiotherapy service was very pleasant. I really like how she treats my dog ​​and how he has regained his mobility after the operation. I am very grateful to the doctor for how she has treated him and for everything she has done to help my dog ​​recover.

It's an excellent veterinary hospital! We received very friendly and professional care, and above all, we got great results. 🐾

Dr. Angy is an excellent doctor, very attentive and professional. We are very grateful for her work and highly recommend her. She is always attentive to the patient and answers any questions, whether at the hospital or via WhatsApp in case of an emergency. 🤍 Words cannot express our gratitude to Dr. Angy and Dr. Camilo for all their care!

Excellent service from Dr. Claudia. She has cared for my dog, Patitas, and from the very first moment, she demonstrated great professionalism and compassion.

Patitas contracted parvovirus, and it was Dr. Claudia who detected it promptly and prescribed the necessary tests and care. I believe that, thanks to her attention and follow-up, my Patitas was able to overcome this very serious virus.

Throughout this time, Dr. Claudia has been very attentive to Patitas's progress, her immune system, and every aspect necessary for her continued health. Patitas is now six months old since recovering from parvovirus, and we continue to benefit from Dr. Claudia's care and support.

We have previously taken other dogs to different veterinarians, but I can say that Dr. Claudia's care has been exemplary. I am completely satisfied and, above all, very grateful for the humane, attentive, and loving way she has treated both us and our pet.

Without a doubt, she is a doctor in whom we have found trust and peace of mind. I'm so happy with their service and all the care they've given my little paws. ❤️🐾
Excellent service; they treat the animals with so much love and respect. My dog ​​is very nervous, but they've done her tests effectively and explained them very well. 👍 Highly recommended.

Impeccable corporate image, but extremely unpunctual. You have to ask about every single action they take because they keep adding it up. I ended up paying almost $4000 and I'm still missing a medication.

I want to share our experience because I think it's important for others to know what happened to us.

On Sunday night, we arrived at this veterinary hospital around 10:30 p.m. with our kitten, who was in very poor condition: he wasn't meowing anymore, he stayed in one place, he was cold, he urinated when we picked him up, and he wouldn't eat anything at all.

When we arrived, there were many people waiting, and we decided to stay, thinking that if there were so many people, it must mean the place had good service. We waited until about 12:30 a.m., when it finally seemed like they would see us. However, at that moment, a young man arrived with his dog and went in before us. The doctor didn't say anything about it. To avoid an argument, we decided to let him go ahead, even though our kitten was very ill.

Finally, around 1:00 a.m., they saw us. The doctor told us that our cat needed to be hospitalized, and of course, we immediately agreed because all we wanted was for him to receive care and be stabilized.

The doctor stepped away for a few minutes to get the paperwork, and when he returned, he told us, “I have good news.” We were surprised and thought he might have found a solution for our kitten. To our shock, he informed us that they didn't have room to hospitalize him at that moment and that we would have to find another place.

This happened at approximately 1:39 a.m., after we had been waiting for almost three hours.

What bothered us most was that if they didn't have room for hospitalization, we felt they should have informed us from the beginning, or at least when they examined our kitten. We could have gone to another hospital sooner and not wasted valuable time while our cat was in that condition.

We left very disappointed and worried, but fortunately, we found another place where they admitted our kitten immediately and began treating him.

I completely understand that a veterinary hospital can be overcrowded and that there aren't always beds available. What I question is the lack of communication and the length of time we had to wait to finally receive a response that could have been given much sooner.

I hope this experience will lead to improvements in their care processes and, above all, to promptly informing owners when they lack the capacity to hospitalize an animal arriving in an emergency.
Hi Kimberly, thank you for taking the time to rate us! Best regards!
Excellent service from the veterinarians, they are very humane and the prices are very affordable, I highly recommend Dr. Marco.
Excellent service

I took my cat to Dermavet Veterinary Hospital because he had a lesion near his ear that had been there for several weeks. It would heal and scab over, but he would keep scratching it until it opened and bled. He also developed another hairless, reddened area on one of his paws.

The care my kitten received was excellent. The facilities are very nice and clean. I loved that they have separate areas for dogs and cats, especially since my cat gets extremely stressed when he goes to the vet.

But what I liked most was that they use low-stress techniques for cats. Although Eros was nervous, he remained much calmer than at other vet appointments. This is very important to me because he usually suffers a lot during these visits.

It also gave me a lot of confidence that they performed a cytology and any other tests they deemed necessary to investigate the cause of his lesions right there, instead of just prescribing medication without first looking for the cause.

The vet who saw us explained in detail what could be causing the problem, the different possibilities, and the treatment options in each case. She prescribed a treatment plan to rule out possible causes and will monitor his progress.

The cost might be a little high, but after the care my cat received, I think it's worth it. I left much more at ease and, above all, happy to have found a place that takes into account both his health and the stress that a veterinary visit can cause. I highly recommend it. 🐱❤️

The facilities were very clean, everyone was very friendly, and Dr. Marco took excellent care of my Asha, answering all our questions. My dog ​​is now undergoing treatment, and I hope everything goes well.
Terrible service from the receptionist
Exceptional, great diagnosis!!!

We were extremely happy with the care my puppy received. From the facilities to the service and attention, everything was excellent. But above all, we want to highlight the care and treatment he received: thanks to their follow-up and dedication, my pet was able to overcome his allergy and is doing much better today. Their professionalism and the care they put into their work are evident. Highly recommended!

The facilities are clean, the staff is very friendly via phone and WhatsApp; Dr. Camilo is an excellent dermatologist, they have the necessary equipment to provide a good diagnosis, he is attentive and careful with patients, they provide follow-up and are punctual for appointments.
Hi Jarquin, thank you so much for your rating! ⭐ We continue working every day with lots of love and dedication for the well-being of your pets.
Hi Noe, thank you so much for your rating! ⭐ We continue working every day with lots of love and dedication for the well-being of your pets.

My kitten was in very, very bad shape. I had taken him somewhere else where they treated him very badly and even made his condition worse, but when he arrived at this hospital, they helped him a lot. They took such good care of him here, and they have the best doctors and equipment—everything is more than professional. Don't hesitate and come here because the lives of our little animals don't deserve to be taken to a local "vet" who, often in order to save money, doesn't see how badly things can go wrong. Don't expose them to that, and come here instead, especially to see Dr. Laura 💙

I took my dog ​​to the dermatologist. Dr. Laura Miranda saw her, and I was very pleased with the care. The doctor was very kind, clear, and precise in her diagnosis. We're currently undergoing treatment, but I saw a noticeable improvement from the very first day. I highly recommend her.

Excellent service. The hospital is very good. From reception to the appointment scheduling process, everything is very simple and the staff is very friendly. We went to the dermatology department for a chronic ear problem, and Dr. Laura is very kind, dedicated, and always clearly explained the progression to us step by step. They have a very complete team and everything necessary for a thorough examination. My dog ​​required surgery, and the care she received was excellent. The team is very dedicated and interested in the well-being of the patients. The facilities are beautiful, clean, and high-quality. The laboratory service is very efficient. I am very grateful for all the care.

Highly recommended! We came here after a lecture by Dr. Camilo, looking for a solution for my cat Masha, who had been suffering for a long time from skin wounds without a clear diagnosis. From the very first appointment, the change was dramatic: she stopped hurting herself and regained her quality of life. All the staff are very professional and attentive. They've already done her allergy tests, and we're finally at ease. I can't thank them enough for the relief they gave us. Excellent place ✨
Very expensive
Arrive early; parking isn't easy. Dr. Camilo is excellent and very experienced in his specialty. He's empathetic and highly recommended.
Excellent care, excellent treatments. Extensive experience in veterinary care.

Excellent service, they treat animals and their owners with humanity and are sensitive to the needs of pets.
They are ethical and professional in their consultations. We took our anxious Rottweiler there for a consultation and delicate surgery. Everything went perfectly, and the treatment was ethical and professional. I highly recommend them.

They were very kind from the moment I arrived. They helped me carry my dog ​​since it was an emergency. They attended to her very quickly and got her tests done very fast. Even though I live a bit far away, I took her there because I saw they had everything she needed for blood tests and x-rays. Unfortunately, there wasn't much they could do. They let me say goodbye to her, and the treatment was very humane. I'm very grateful.

The place is very well maintained, clean, and the facilities and services are top-notch. I took my dog ​​in when she was very unwell, and Dr. Marco Antonio Sánchez truly saved her. They have definitely become our go-to veterinarians 🙏✨ …

The service has always been very pleasant; they've treated both me and my pet well. They take into account whether your dog can be around other dogs for safety reasons. :) Even though they seem to have many clients, they always respect your appointment time and never make you wait more than 5 minutes. I've spoken with some other clients, and they're all happy with the service and their diagnoses. I think the price is reasonable considering it's a specialty, and the products they sell are also very good quality and reasonably priced. :) I've highly recommended them!

The care my dog ​​Sofia received was excellent. They examined her with great care and professionalism, provided her with treatment that helped her recover from her health problem, and followed up with her every step of the way.
They have excellent facilities and trained staff.
The service is excellent; everyone is very kind.

Dr. Miguel provided excellent care, patiently explaining the diagnosis in detail. He has always been attentive to my dog's treatment. The service is very good, the facilities are clean, and they treat the dogs with great love.
Excellent service

I am very, very satisfied with Dr. Camilo's care. I had been to two other veterinarians before, and neither could give a correct diagnosis for my dog. I spent a lot on consultations and medications, and nothing worked. Only he provided the solution, and he even knew why I was feeling unwell, which I really appreciated because I also spent a lot on doctors, and they didn't know what was wrong with me either. My dog ​​is doing very well with the treatment. Even though he is quite far from my house, I know for sure that I will continue to go here for appointments.
Good service, they explain things very well. But it's very expensive.
Good service

Excellent service from all the doctors; they treat you calmly and patiently, explaining everything related to the dog's illness. They have a laboratory and x-ray facilities, among other tests, which speed up diagnosis and treatment.
Excellent service, one of the best for dermatological care in the area, very reasonable prices
Excellent service, they explain things well, and a huge thank you to Dr. Angy, very professional and you can see her love for her profession.

They provide very comprehensive care at an affordable price. Unfortunately, my baby had no other option, and they gave us the choice to euthanize him to avoid prolonging his suffering. After so many places, here we received an accurate diagnosis immediately. The cremation service was efficient. We are very grateful to Woobin and its owners for their time, quality, and the care they provide.
Excellent service and a great place for your pet.
They never answer the phone.

I was recommended Dr. Camilo Romero, a veterinarian I went to in desperation because my dog ​​was very ill and had already been examined by several doctors without improvement. I was told he was one of the best, if not the best, in the country. He truly exceeded my expectations. The care is excellent, and Dr. Romero is completely professional and compassionate. He diagnosed my dog ​​almost at first glance and also saved me money on tests that were difficult for me to afford at the time. He promised I would see another dog within a week, and he did. I am so grateful to him and his team; I highly recommend him.
At first the consultation seemed expensive, but the truth is they are quite professional and very attentive.

Dr. Quetzalli treated my senior dog wonderfully. She had a kidney problem and had to stay in the hospital for a few days.
Excellent care and attention 🙏 …
Excellent treatment of my pet; the veterinarians take the time to explain and examine the patient. Excellent service.

Dr. Camilo and his entire team (Dr. Laura, Dr. Angie, Dr. Andrea, Dr. Quetzalli, Dr. Cristian, the lab technicians, the receptionists—the whole Dermavet team 🫶🏻 are superheroes to all their patients. I've always had a very special and professional experience.
Thank you so much for always staying up-to-date and looking after our dogs. Nutella is 1000% Dermavet. ✨
Good service.

Excellent service, I was very satisfied when they managed to help my dog ​​recover from Parvovirus. They took great care of her at all times, and they explained everything and answered all your questions.
The service from Dr. Claudia was excellent...

The veterinarian's care was excellent and very empathetic, even though it was just an ultrasound.

My only complaint is that my appointment was at 4:30 pm and I arrived at 5 pm, but overall everything was great.

This hospital was good, until I had an emergency and they never treated me urgently. The morning they answered, they said the appointment was in four days and that if I thought it was urgent, I should go somewhere else. Terrible.
Excellent service and accurate diagnoses, I highly recommend it

My dog's name is Princesa. She came in with a hormonal imbalance and had an excellent ovulation test. The surgery was fantastic; she walked out without pain. Later, she became very ill with intestinal problems. We've had this problem since she was a puppy 😵‍💫 She wouldn't eat because of the pain and inflammation in her stomach and intestines. Dr. Camilo treated her; he's an excellent veterinarian with extensive experience. He was very clear and started treating her right away. He's very humane with animals. Fortunately, she survived, and now she's a healthy dog. We are very grateful to Dr. Camilo and Dr. Andrea, who is also an excellent doctor. They are both very good, and we highly recommend them. You might think it's expensive because it's a hospital, but they are very fair with their prices. Don't hesitate to leave your beloved pets, our fur babies, in excellent hands! Thank you so much, Dr. Camilo and Dr. Andrea!
Everyone is very friendly and the doctors are among the best in Mexico City...

Excellent service for pets. They have specialists, a very professional and empathetic staff, and they provide a complete diagnosis and explain all the necessary procedures and the treatment your pet will receive.

I am grateful to Dr. Marco and Dr. Angie, as well as Dr. Andrea, who assisted us with the diagnosis, surgery, treatment, and recovery of my dog.

The facilities are very good and have everything necessary to provide excellent care.

I took my kittens to the vet, one of them very ill. I felt like he wasn't going to make it, but Dr. Marco Sánchez treated us with incredible patience and clear explanations. Every time we go, he's warm and respectful, and he's managed to bring all three of them back to health.

The place is very nice, with areas for everything, always taking care of our pets and us. What I liked most is that they answer your questions right away. If an ultrasound, blood tests, stool samples, urine tests, etc., are needed, they do the necessary tests on the spot, which makes for more accurate diagnoses.

Dr. Marco followed up with my kittens until they were well, keeping an eye on everything and providing guidance when needed.

It's a bit pricey, but it's a good place for our pets. It's worth the effort to treat them as if they were our own. Again, they receive excellent care, are treated with love, and always with respect.

The doctor kept me informed throughout the treatment process. He explained the test results very well and sent them to me via WhatsApp, as well as the ultrasound results for my sickest kitten. He sent me videos of him eating and other important moments from his hospital stay. I even had time to visit my kitten because the doctor understands how important it is for us to be present for our beloved pet's recovery during those times.

I placed all my trust in veterinarian Marco, and thanks to the clinic, my kittens are now healthy and with me.

I took my dog ​​in for treatment of a cracked leg. They told us they were going to sedate her to set the bone and immobilize it. When we picked her up, the leg they had "treated" was one that wasn't injured, with no signs of having been anesthetized. When we pointed out their mistake, they said they would "set" her leg as it was (partially sedated or not sedated at all). The name of the "doctor" who performed the consultation is not on file; she doesn't have a professional license as an orthopedist or as a veterinarian in general. It's important to emphasize that the consultation we went for was orthopedic (which is more expensive). Please consider whether this is the care you want for your pets.
Everything was fine with the specialist, however the service in the reception area was very slow.

They took excellent care of my kitten, ran tests, and he was hospitalized for two days. I think the price was reasonable.
The veterinarians were very kind and empathetic; the facilities were clean and comfortable, including the hospitalization area.
They accept card payments.

I've known Dr. Camilo for several years and I know he's an excellent doctor. If there's one thing I can be sure of, it's that he'll always order the necessary tests to arrive at the correct diagnosis and treatment.
A top-notch hospital ✨
Excellent service from all the staff; they are very professional. They also have all the necessary, state-of-the-art equipment. A top-notch clinic. Special thanks to Dr. Camilo.
Excellent attention and service from all the staff, highly recommended 👍 👌 …
Excellent service
Very good service
Excellent service for my friends
She really messed up our dog. She took a lot of money from us for supposed injections and kept recommending Apoquel. We kept calling and messaging her, and apparently she blocked us.

I'm so happy with the top-notch care. My dog ​​arrived in very bad shape, and thanks to the vet, chemotherapy was ruled out in favor of Cliotherapy, saving her a lot of money and suffering. Now she's very happy without so much medication! 😀 …

Everyone is incredibly kind and professional. They have excellent facilities. My cat is very grateful to them because she's healthy thanks to the timely attention, care, and follow-up they've provided. Dr. Laura Miranda has treated us wonderfully and given us very clear explanations of Mordisko's condition, treatment, and the care we need. I highly recommend both the doctor and the hospital.
